# Comparisons

This folder contains the structured comparison tables and cross-sectional analyses for the Danish ADHD quality database (ADHD-DATABASEN). It documents demographic breakdowns of the national assessment and treatment populations, early assessment terminations, and detailed performance metrics for 11 clinical and educational quality indicators. These pages benchmark regional and departmental compliance against national standards—such as the 90% development target for timely somatic assessments, diagnostic interviews, specialist conferences, and psychoeducation—while also tracking longitudinal trends, systemic failures in cross-sectoral collaboration, and persistent educational deficits for youth with ADHD compared to the background population.

## Pages

- [[adhd-behandlingspopulation|ADHD-behandlingspopulation]] — Demographic breakdown of the ADHD treatment population by age, gender, and region, highlighting regional volume disparities and male dominance across cohorts.
- [[adhd-udredningspopulation|ADHD-udredningspopulation]] — Demographic analysis of the ADHD assessment population, showing volume differences across age groups and Danish regions.
- [[antal-udredningsforloeb-afsluttet-indenfor-90-dage-pga-mistanke-afkraeftet|Antal udredningsforløb afsluttet indenfor 90 dage pga. mistanke afkræftet]] — Tracks the number of assessments concluded early due to disproven suspicion, revealing massive regional outliers like Region Syddanmark and clinic-level spikes in Midtjylland.
- [[indikator-1|Indikator 1]] — Compares regional and departmental compliance with somatic assessments within 120 days, showing widespread failure to meet the 90% national standard despite isolated clinic successes.
- [[indikator-10|Indikator 10]] — Evaluates the assessment of social support needs for adult ADHD patients within 120 days, where no region or department meets the development target.
- [[indikator-11|Indikator 11]] — Measures the proportion of adult treatment courses involving pharmacological treatment, highlighting Region Nordjylland as a leader and Region Hovedstaden as a significant low-performing outlier.
- [[indikator-2a|Indikator 2a]] — Tracks clinical environmental observations for 0–5-year-olds within 120 days, contrasting high performers like Region Syddanmark with trailing regions and private hospitals.
- [[indikator-2b-andelen-af-udredningsforloeb-blandt-6-17-aarige-hvor-der-senest-120-dage-efter-start-af-adhd-udredning-er-foretaget-enten-manualiseret-diagnostisk-interview-eller-miljoeobservation|"Indikator 2b: Andelen af udredningsforløb blandt 6-17 årige, hvor der, senest 120 dage efter start af ADHD-udredning, er foretaget enten manualiseret diagnostisk interview eller miljøobservation"]] — Detailed 2023/24 compliance data for diagnostic interviews or observations in 6–17-year-olds, noting Odense as the sole clinic meeting the standard.
- [[indikator-2b|Indikator 2b]] — Broad comparison of interview and observation compliance for 6–17-year-olds across multiple years, showing severe regional inequalities and private hospital failures.
- [[indikator-3-andelen-af-udredningsforloeb-hvor-der-er-afholdt-diagnostisk-konference-med-deltagelse-af-speciallaege-i-boerne-og-ungdomspsykiatri-senest-120-dage-efter-start-af-adhd-udredning|"Indikator 3: Andelen af udredningsforløb, hvor der er afholdt diagnostisk konference med deltagelse af speciallæge i børne- og ungdomspsykiatri senest 120 dage efter start af ADHD-udredning"]] — Historical and regional data on diagnostic conferences with specialists, illustrating a systemic failure to meet the 90% target across all regions.
- [[indikator-3|Indikator 3]] — Tracks diagnostic conference compliance for the 2024/25 period, highlighting a dramatic improvement in Region Midtjylland amid general national shortfalls.
- [[indikator-4|Indikator 4]] — Compares the fulfillment of coordinating network meetings within 90 days of treatment start, exposing extreme departmental outliers and universal target failure.
- [[indikator-5|Indikator 5]] — Measures ADHD-related psychoeducation rates for children and parents within 120 days, showing Region Midtjylland leading while private hospitals score zero.
- [[indikator-6|Indikator 6]] — Analyzes medical treatment rates for the child and youth ADHD treatment population, identifying Region Nordjylland and the Bornholm clinic as consistent leaders.
- [[indikator-7a|Indikator 7a]] — Compares primary school leaving exam pass rates for the ADHD assessment population against the background population, revealing a persistent 25–30 percentage point deficit.
- [[indikator-7b|Indikator 7b]] — Benchmarks school leaving exam pass rates for the ADHD treatment population against national averages, showing Region Hovedstaden leading but still trailing the background population.
- [[indikator-8|Indikator 8]] — Evaluates psychoeducation initiation for adult ADHD patients within 120 days, with specific clinics like Tønder approaching the target while regions fall short.
- [[indikator-9|Indikator 9]] — Tracks the provision of psychotherapy for adults when deemed relevant, showing a massive systemic failure with a national compliance rate of just 1%.
- [[indikatoroversigt|Indikatoroversigt]] — Defines the 13 clinical and educational quality indicators, their types, and their development targets, establishing the baseline expectations for the healthcare system.
- [[oversigt-over-de-samlede-indikatorresultater|Oversigt over de samlede indikatorresultater]] — Aggregates performance across all 13 indicators over three years, highlighting systemic failures in cross-sectoral collaboration and declining educational outcomes.
